title: Accounts Administrator
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Accounts Administrator on a temp to perm basis.

This is a great opportunity to join an established Swindon based company, working within the Customer Service / Planning team.

As a Accounts Administrator you will provide high-quality administrative support and deliver excellent customer service to key clients and external partners.

About the Accounts Administrator Role:
- Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9am-5:30pm
- Annual salary 27,936 per annum
- Office based role in Swindon (SN3)
- Temporary to permanent role
- Start date is October 2026

Duties & Responsibilities for the Accounts Administrator role:
- Invoice preperation, data checks & validation
- Responsibilty for raising & reconciling weekly invoices
- Process cancellations & postponements
- KPI management

To be considered for the Accounts Administrator role apply today!

title: Accounts Payable Analyst
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst Swindon

Opportunity:

Are you currently working in accounts payable dealing with invoices? Does your experience include managing payment controls and dealing with supplier payments? Want to work for a large pharmaceutical manufacturing company? Yes then this is the role for you!

Your role as an Accounts Payable Analyst based in Swindon will involve processing supplier invoices, completing appropriate checks for business approval and/or PO matches and entering the invoice details onto the ERP system.

Duties and responsibilities include:
- Processing supplier invoices with precision, ensuring correct approvals and purchase order matching.
- Entering invoice data into the companies ERP system accurately and efficiently.
- Upholding compliance with internal controls and company payment policies.
- Managing supplier queries, invoice matching, indexing, and coding.

This is a 6 months contract which will be reviewed for a possible extension or go permanent however this is dependent on the candidate and business performance. The PAYE rate is £13.58 per hour.

Skills:

To apply for the Accounts Payable Analyst role you will have the following skills:
- Accounts Payable process experience.
- Working with suppliers.
- Excellent verbal, analytical, inter-personal skills.
- A team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

How to Apply:

To apply for this one off opportunity, please send a word copy of your CV to me now by clicking on the Apply button or call me for a confidential chat. Please ensure you have read and agree to our Privacy Policy which can be found on the Quality Start website.

If this sounds like the role for you or a colleague then please do not hesitate to contact us. If we manage to successfully fill a permanent placement from your recommendation then we will send you a cheque of £300. We also have many incentive schemes for referring contractors/temp staff so please contact us with the referral and we can provide you with more information.

For a list of our current vacancies, please visit the Quality Start website.

If you do not hear from Quality Start within 2 weeks your CV has not been short listed for this role.

Quality Start are acting as a specialist recruitment consultancy for this role.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
Location: Westbury
Hourly Rate: £12.71 per hour
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:30pm (40 hours per week)
Job Type: Full Time Permanent
About the Role
Tru Talent is delighted to be working with a well-established client who is looking for an organised and detail-focused Credit Controller to join their Finance Team in Westbury.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in credit control and accounts receivable who can manage customer accounts, monitor outstanding debt and help maintain effective cash flow.
A day in the life of a Credit Controller:
Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing customer accounts and credit limits in line with company policies.
- Monitoring aged debt and proactively contacting customers to secure outstanding payments.
- Resolving payment queries and account discrepancies professionally.
- Allocating incoming payments accurately and completing account reconciliations.
- Prioritising overdue and high-risk accounts to minimise financial exposure.
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve billing issues.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring compliance with company procedures.

Skills needed for the Credit Controller Role:
To be successful, you will have:
- Previous experience in credit control or accounts receivable.
- Experience managing customer accounts, collections and aged debt.
- Knowledge of cash allocation and account reconciliation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Confident communication skills when discussing payments with customers.
- A professional, resilient and proactive approach.
- The ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality.

title: Credit Controller - Accounts Receivable
description:
Credit Controller - Accounts Receivable

Location: Westbury, Wiltshire
Salary: £26,436.80 annual 40 hours per week
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm
Benefits: 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays, birthday leave, pension, enhanced family leave pay and wellbeing support

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

ISQ Recruitment is recruiting a Credit Controller for a well-established automotive business in Westbury. This is an opportunity to take ownership of customer accounts within a busy finance team, with weekday working hours, ongoing development and a comprehensive benefits package.

If you have experience in credit control, accounts receivable or sales ledger collections, this role offers the chance to put your skills to work managing overdue balances, resolving queries and building positive customer relationships.

The Role
You will support the business's cash flow by keeping customer accounts accurate and payments on track. Working closely with customers and internal departments, you will investigate discrepancies, prioritise overdue debt and help resolve issues that delay payment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and review credit limits in accordance with company procedures.
- Monitor aged debt and follow up overdue invoices by telephone and email.
- Secure payments while maintaining professional customer relationships.
- Allocate incoming payments accurately and reconcile customer accounts.
- Investigate invoice disputes, payment differences and account queries.
- Work with internal teams to resolve billing discrepancies promptly.
- Identify higher-risk balances and maintain clear records of collection activity.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience managing customer accounts, aged debt and payment collections.
- A sound understanding of credit control and accounts receivable processes.
- Experience with cash allocation and account reconciliation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident communication skills and a professional approach to payment discussions.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A discreet approach to confidential financial information.

What's on Offer
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with an increase after five years' service.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Company pension and death-in-service benefit of four times salary.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Employee Assistance Programme, wellbeing support and access to a 24-hour online GP.
- Training, mentoring and opportunities for career development.
- Employee recognition and long-service rewards.

Appointment may be subject to a satisfactory DBS check. Please let ISQ Recruitment know if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process.

To apply, please click apply or send your CV to (url removed). For more information, please contact ISQ Recruitment on (phone number removed).

ISQ Recruitment Ltd is acting as an employment agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Part-time Finance Officer
description:
We're excited to be working on the behalf of a well-regarded local heritage charity, who are seeking a new Finance Officer to join their friendly team. Duties will include:
- Banking and reconciling weekly takings, identifying any discrepancies
- Sales invoices & credit control
- Processing purchase invoices and making payment runs
- Processing monthly payroll & pensions
- Preparation of monthly management accounts & financial reporting
- Preparing and submitting Gift Aid returns
- Monitoring cash flow
- Quarterly VAT returns including partial exemption
- Liaising with auditors regarding annual accouns
- Other general duties such as assisting with HR as needed, liaising with various members of other departments to ensure everything runs smoothly, participating in training and development as needed, etc

You will need previous experience using Xero software for accounts, and any knowledge of Sage HR /Payroll would be beneficial. A background in charity accounting would be highly beneficial / knowledge of Gift Aid / partial exemption VAT, etc, however this is not essential. AAT Level 4 or equivalent qualification would be beneficial, however the charity can considered those qualified by experience. This role would definitely suit anyone with an interest in heritage / history / education.

The organisation are looking for someone to work circa 21 hours per week and can be flexible regarding how this is spread, to suit the right candidate. They would like the person to be in-office.

title: Sales Ledger Assistant
description:
Sales Ledger Assistant
Location: Wootton Bassett
Salary: 32,000
Hours: Full-time, office-based, Monday to Friday
We are recruiting for an experienced Sales Ledger Assistant to join a busy finance team. This role would suit someone with a strong background in Sales Ledger who is confident managing sales order processing, invoicing, debtor management and resolving account discrepancies.
Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly sales orders, invoices and credit notes.
- Check timesheets and clock cards against hours sold.
- Match customer purchase orders to invoices.
- Maintain the Sales Ledger and manage aged debtors.
- Investigate and resolve customer account discrepancies.
- Maintain outstanding sales order records.
- Liaise with customers, the Sales Team and Business Managers.
- Support the wider finance team with ad hoc duties.

About You
- At least 5 years' experience in Sales Ledger, including sales orders, invoicing and debtor management.
- Excellent Excel skills are essential, including confidence working with spreadsheets and workbooks.
- Good knowledge of accounting systems; Exchequer experience is advantageous.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines.
- Confident communicator with a proactive, can-do attitude.
- Able to work independently and as part of a team.

If you have extensive Sales Ledger experience and excellent Excel skills, we'd love to hear from you. Apply directly.
